Class NetworkSetupViewController

java.lang.Object
view.NetworkSetupViewController
All Implemented Interfaces:
SceneController, ViewController
public class NetworkSetupViewController extends Object implements SceneController
First connection screen. Collects host, port, and transport then tries to connect to the server. On failure, it shows the connection error. On success, the SceneRouter moves the screen view forward to the nickname choosing view.
